Aetna FL PPO 1500 80/50 CY V25

Carrier: Aetna. Plan type: PPO. Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

26 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 1 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document AETNA_PPO_1500_80_50 (schema version 1.1.0).

extension.valueString: Coverage Period: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026 | FL PPO 1500 80/50 CY V25 | Coverage for: Employee + Family | Plan Type: PPO
What is the overall deductible? In-network: Individual $1,500 / Family $3,000
What is the out-of-pocket limit for this plan? In-network: Individual $5,500 / Family $11,000.
Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $25 copay/visit, deductible does not apply; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
Specialist visit: $75 copay/visit, deductible does not apply; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
Diagnostic test (x-ray, blood work): 20% coinsurance in-network; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
Imaging (CT/PET scans, MRIs): 20% coinsurance in-network; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
Preferred generic drugs: Copay/ prescription, deductible does not apply: Tier 1A: $3 for up to a 30 day supply
Preferred brand drugs: $45 for up to a 30 day supply, $90 for up to a 90 day supply
Specialty drugs: Preferred: 20% coinsurance for up to a 30 day supply; Not covered out-of-network
Emergency room care: 20% coinsurance after $300 copay/visit (in-network and out-of-network). Copay waived if admitted.
Emergency medical transportation: 20% coinsurance. Out-of-network cost-share same as in-network.
Urgent care: $75 copay/visit, deductible does not apply; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
If you have a hospital stay - Facility fee (e.g., hospital room): 20% coinsurance; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
Rehabilitation services: $75 copay/visit; 50% coinsurance out-of-network. Coverage is limited to 60 visits for Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech Therapy & Chiropractic care combined.
Durable medical equipment: 50% coinsurance; 50% coinsurance out-of-network
Children's eye exam: No charge in-network. Coverage is limited to 1 exam every 12 months.
Children's glasses: Not covered. Children's dental check-up: Not covered.
Yes. Certain office visits, preventive care, urgent care and prescription drugs in-network.
